title: Payroll run delayed for Tuesday pay cycle

title: Timesheet approval button unresponsive
description: Managers could not approve timesheets; the approve action spun indefinitely. Reported by 1498 managers before the pay cutoff.
resolution_summary: Rolled back a front-end release that broke the approval form and added an end-to-end test for the approval flow.

title: Auto-scheduler ignoring availability
description: The auto-scheduler assigned shifts to employees outside their stated availability for 1322 shifts.
resolution_summary: Corrected the availability filter in the scheduling rules and regenerated affected schedules.

title: Password reset emails not arriving
description: Users requesting a password reset did not receive the email. 2695 reset requests went undelivered over 218 minutes.
resolution_summary: The email provider's rate limit was raised and the queued reset emails were re-sent.

title: Dependent coverage missing after enrollment
description: Employees who added dependents saw only employee-only coverage on their confirmation. 948 enrollments were affected.
resolution_summary: Fixed the dependent mapping in the enrollment save step and reprocessed affected enrollments.

title: Labor cost report failing to generate
description: The labor cost report failed with a timeout for large organizations. 4415 report requests failed.
resolution_summary: Paginated the report query and moved large reports to asynchronous generation with email delivery.

title: HRIS employee sync failing
description: The nightly employee sync from the customer's HR system failed. 3057 employee changes were not applied.
resolution_summary: The partner API changed a field format; the mapping was updated and the sync re-run.

title: SMS alerts not delivered
description: SMS shift alerts failed for 33% of recipients for 209 minutes.
resolution_summary: Failed over to the secondary SMS provider and re-sent failed alerts.

title: Shift swap requests stuck pending

title: Duplicate email notifications sent

resolution_summary: Made the notification sender idempotent with a per-message deduplication key.

title: Exported CSV missing columns

resolution_summary: Fixed the export column mapping for custom fields and added a regression test.

title: Published schedules showing wrong week
description: Employees viewing their schedule saw the previous week's shifts after publishing on Saturday.
resolution_summary: Fixed a cache key that ignored the week start date and cleared the schedule cache.

title: Clock-in punches not syncing from terminals

resolution_summary: The punch sync queue was backed up; it was drained and its consumer capacity increased. Missing punches were backfilled.
